categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: transportation services including container, bulk, hazardous materials, and oil transportation, and fuel retail through its network of gas stations. Additional businesses include vehicle sales, automotive repair, vehicle inspection services, warehousing, customs brokerage, and environmental testing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs digital transformation and cloud computing technologies to enhance operational efficiency, including smart fueling stations with real-time data transmission, touch interfaces, voice advertising, and multi-energy support. It integrates transport management systems (TMS), enterprise resource planning (ERP), and advanced information security measures such as zero trust architecture, multi-factor authentication, and endpoint security. The company also uses GPS and DVR for vehicle monitoring and safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include general consumers purchasing fuel at gas stations and corporate clients requiring integrated logistics, shipping, warehousing, and fuel supply services. The company serves the domestic Taiwanese market primarily, focusing on both retail consumers and large enterprise clients, including shipping and logistics sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan with a network of 74 gas stations distributed nationwide and transport services covering northern, central, and southern Taiwan. The company also has overseas subsidiaries and investments in locations such as Shanghai, Vietnam, and the British Virgin Islands, supporting international logistics and investment activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the downstream segment of the oil supply chain through its retail gas stations and midstream in transportation and logistics services. It also provides integrated supply chain services including warehousing, customs brokerage, and vehicle maintenance, positioning itself as a comprehensive logistics and fuel service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include digital transformation, smart station upgrades, data-driven management, and integration of transport and fuel operations. R&D focuses on energy efficiency, automation, intelligent systems for self-service fueling and car wash, enterprise membership management, and cybersecurity enhancements. The company aims to develop sustainable and circular economy initiatives and strengthen supply chain collaboration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through fuel sales at gas stations and transportation service fees. Additional income streams include vehicle sales, automotive repair services, warehousing fees, and value-added logistics services. The company also leverages digital platforms and membership services to enhance customer retention and generate recurring revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks among the top fuel retailers in Taiwan, competing with major players such as CPC Corporation (Taiwan) and Formosa Petrochemical Corporation. It holds a stable market share with a strong presence in both fuel retail and logistics sectors, recognized for quality service and operational efficiency. The company is noted for its early adoption of digital and smart technologies in the industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$10.8 billion, a 34% decline from the previous year, primarily due to station upgrades causing temporary operational shutdowns. It recorded a net loss of NT$446.6 million with negative earnings per share of NT$3.43. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets around NT$8.8 billion and is focused on stabilizing growth through operational improvements and digital transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes quality, safety, and customer experience through smart fueling technology, integrated logistics solutions, and comprehensive service offerings. Its value proposition includes convenience via digital platforms, multi-energy support at stations, professional environmental and safety management, and strong supply chain partnerships. The company differentiates itself by combining traditional fuel retail with advanced digital and sustainable practices.
